newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Two Romanian banks buy new 91-day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Two Romanian banks buy new 91-day T-bills.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said two banks subscribed to a total 76.9 billion lei in Finance Ministry three-month treasury bills put on offer at Thursday's session.

Banca Romana de Comert Exterior Bancorex SA and Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA bought the bills, which mature on January 9, 1997 and were offered with a coupon giving an annual yield of 50.35 percent.
Last month, the Finance Ministry launched 500 billion lei in new 91-day T-bills to be placed by the BNR in four public subscription sessions.

The last public subscription is scheduled for October 24, when some 225 billion lei worth of T-bills will be on offer at an annual yield equal with the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five working days ahead of the session.
